name: Kimpton St Honore Paris
positioning: Kimpton St Honoré Paris, a hotel in Paris with Art Deco-inspired rooms by designer Charles Zana, a Californian restaurant, a rooftop bar and a Codage spa
best_for: Travelers who like design and a historic building

facts.text: Interior designer Charles Zana designed the guest rooms and suites.
The rooms take their inspiration from 1930s Art Deco elements with a contemporary twist.
Much of the building's historic department-store interior remains intact, including a spiral stairway and interior balconies.
The Montecito restaurant serves modern Californian cuisine.
The Montecito menu was co-created by recipe developer and author Carrie Solomon.
The Sequoia rooftop bar and garden has 360-degree views.
The hotel has a Codage spa with a sauna, steam room, two treatment rooms and an indoor pool.
Pets of any size, weight or breed are welcome at no extra charge.
The hotel is a short distance from the Opéra, Place Vendôme and the Church of the Madeleine.
The Louvre Museum is accessible by foot or train.

highlights.text: Much of the building's historic department-store interior remains intact, including a spiral stairway and interior balconies.
Condé Nast Traveler describes the hotel as the first Kimpton property in France.
Interior designer Charles Zana designed the guest rooms and suites.
The Sequoia rooftop bar and garden has 360-degree views.
The hotel offers a daily complimentary social hour with drinks and nibbles.

considerations.text: Condé Nast Traveler notes the Codage spa and pool occupy a small area.
Condé Nast Traveler notes that guests in boulevard-facing rooms who are sensitive to noise may want ear plugs.
WhataHotel notes the boutique size may limit availability during peak seasons.
